title: Metal Desk Rate Card for Escalation of a Quoted Total
content:
# Metal Desk Rate Card for Escalation of a Quoted Total

1.8 per cent, 1.1 per cent and 0.6 per cent of the quoted total for each whole period the price has aged past the revaluation window are the escalations this desk charges on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three is taken turns on the metal the piece is to be made in and on the metal price the quote was built at.

## Rates

| Where | The escalation for each such period is |
|---|---|
| The piece is to be made in platinum or in palladium and the metal price the quote was built at stands at or above the studio's high metal price, which is USD 40.00 per gram | 1.8 per cent of the quoted total |
| The piece is to be made in an eighteen karat gold and the metal price the quote was built at stands at or above USD 40.00 per gram | 1.1 per cent of the quoted total |
| Otherwise | The studio's standard escalation, 0.6 per cent of the quoted total |

The metal the piece is to be made in stands on the commission record. The metal price the quote was built at is the price per gram carried on the commission's own entry for the original quote.

## Which metals fall where

- Platinum or palladium: platinum 950; palladium 500.
- An eighteen karat gold: 18-karat yellow gold; 18-karat white gold; 18-karat rose gold.
- Neither: 14-karat yellow gold; 14-karat white gold.

## Both sides of the price level (hypothetical)

A commission quoted at USD 20000.00 with 3 whole periods counted:

| Metal and price the quote was built at | Rate | Escalation |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum 950 at USD 40.00 per gram | 1.8 per cent | USD 1080.00 |
| Platinum 950 at USD 39.99 per gram | 0.6 per cent | USD 360.00 |
| 18-karat white gold at USD 52.00 per gram | 1.1 per cent | USD 660.00 |
| 14-karat yellow gold at USD 60.00 per gram | 0.6 per cent | USD 360.00 |
